crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:d3.title: Industrial Operations Specialist
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:d3.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel is seeking an Industrial Operations Specialist to help drive operational excellence across our manufacturing environment. This role is ideal for someone with a background in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Manufacturing, or Operations who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, leading projects, and working directly with production teams. Rather than sitting behind a desk designing products, you'll be on the plant floor identifying opportunities, improving workflows, supporting operations, and helping our teams deliver results safely, efficiently, and with exceptional quality.
responsibilities: As an Industrial Operations Specialist, you'll serve as a key contributor to operational performance by partnering with production, quality, maintenance, and leadership teams to improve how work gets done.
Responsibilities include:
Analyze manufacturing processes and workflows to identify opportunities for improvement.
Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, and cost reduction.
Develop and maintain process documentation, standard work, and operating procedures.
Coordinate and support operational projects from planning through implementation.
Assist with production planning, workflow optimization, and resource utilization.
Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for operational challenges.
Monitor performance metrics and provide recommendations based on data analysis.
Evaluate equipment, tools, and processes to improve operational effectiveness.
Support Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of business objectives.
qualifications: We're seeking individuals who are naturally curious, analytical, and energized by solving real-world manufacturing challenges.
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology, Operations Management, or a related field.
0-5 years of experience in manufacturing, industrial operations, process improvement, production, project management, or continuous improvement.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into actionable improvements.
Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, or Operational Excellence principles is preferred.
Strong communication and project coordination skills.
Ability to build relationships and work effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other business software applications.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b1de2ee2-206c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Operations Analyst based in France. This is a data-first role focused on turning marketing and commercial data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll play a key role in tracking performance across global marketing functions and improving reporting quality. Working closely with Demand Generation and other teams, you’ll help strengthen processes and enable better decision-making. You’ll manage recurring reports and dashboards while also investigating ad hoc questions and performance trends. The role combines data analysis, reporting, data quality, and cross-functional collaboration in a fast-paced environment. It’s well suited to someone who enjoys exploring complex datasets, solving problems, and continuously improving how teams work. You’ll also have opportunities to use AI and modern analytics tools to make reporting and analysis faster and more effective. Own the preparation and delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales and marketing performance reports. Maintain recurring dashboards and reports that serve as a reliable single source of truth, ensuring documentation is clear, accurate, and accessible. Perform regular data-quality checks across multiple sources to identify and resolve issues affecting reporting accuracy. Build and maintain Salesforce CRM reports to answer ad hoc questions around product, campaign, and programme performance. Use CRM, business intelligence, attribution, and AI-powered tools to analyse complex datasets and configure dashboards for internal stakeholders. Analyse programme performance against KPIs, identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities to improve measurement and outcomes. Deliver actionable insights to marketing stakeholders, with a particular focus on supporting Demand Generation decision-making. Manage incoming data and reporting requests independently, escalating only the most complex or strategic projects. Collaborate cross-functionally to improve reporting processes, data quality, and the overall effectiveness of marketing operations. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Excel, including the ability to build formulas, work with large datasets, and navigate spreadsheets confidently. Genuine interest in data, reporting, and analysis, with a preference for analytical work over campaign execution or creative marketing. Experience in a data-heavy or commercially focused function such as Marketing Operations, Marketing Analytics, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, FP&A, or a similar area. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the curiosity to investigate beyond surface-level numbers and identify meaningful insights. Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working collaboratively across different departments and stakeholder groups. Willingness and ability to adopt AI tools to improve analytical workflows, reporting efficiency, and the quality of insights. Adaptability and a demonstrated ability to learn new systems, tools, and processes quickly.
